Driver's Note: The drivers, while bringing the material in motor vehicles into NFC premises, shall carry th eir respective original driving license to facilitate security checks properly before entering inside NFC prem ises without any delay. This will not in any way prejudice the other rights of the purchaser under the terms and conditions of the Contract. PAYMENT TERM : Payment will be made on pro-rata basis as per supply .
